name: TCS Marking as a Service (TCS iON Digital Marking Hub)
target_customers: educational institutions, exam bodies and boards (managed marking service)

handwritten_reading.evidence: Answer booklets are scanned and marked by human evaluators; no machine reading of handwriting documented

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: Human evaluators mark; the 'integrated AI platform' is described as intelligent controls to prevent human errors, not AI marking

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: Not documented on the service page

partial_marks_feedback.evidence: Page mentions 'personalized feedback with analytics-driven insights' but not per-question reasons

typed_answers.evidence: 2019 release: evaluators trained to evaluate textual and spoken (audio) responses; platform supports video, audio and paper-pen marking

indian_languages.evidence: Service 'can be customized for different languages and subjects'; no Indian language named

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Four-step process includes scanning answer booklets with quality checks

teacher_review.evidence: Human evaluator marking with seeding methodology and analytics to track evaluator consistency

public_api.evidence: Not documented; page cites TCS iON platform integration with other platforms and in-house markers

scale.funding_or_owner_notes: Unit of TCS. Offers a pool of certified evaluators on demand; 2019 EFLU partnership to train evaluators; named client Sapix Yozemi Group (Japan) for spoken English marking

notable_2025_2026: TCS and Coempt were the final technically qualified bidders for CBSE's on-screen marking contract; CBSE chose Coempt in December 2025 on price (as reported).

name: TracMARKS
target_customers: universities, school boards, certification and professional bodies

handwritten_reading.evidence: Scripts are scanned and marked on screen by evaluators; no machine reading of handwriting documented

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: Evaluators annotate and grade scripts on the platform; no AI marking documented for TracMARKS

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: Page mentions a 'standardized marking process' but no per-question scheme feature

partial_marks_feedback.evidence: Evaluators can annotate, highlight and grade scripts; written reasons per question not documented

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Digitally scan and store answer scripts; handles high volumes of scripts

annotated_copy.evidence: Annotation tools on platform; 2017 news report: marked scripts converted to PDF with annotations (third-party)

teacher_review.evidence: Human evaluator marking with real-time monitoring of evaluator performance and audit trails

public_api.evidence: Integrates with existing examination management systems; no public API documented

scale.customers_claimed: Over 55 million assessments delivered; 500+ global organizations (company-wide, not OSM-specific). 2017 report: OSM work with Mumbai University, Manipal University, Kerala Technical University
scale.funding_or_owner_notes: Bengaluru-based testing and assessment company founded 2000

name: Onmark
company: Coempt Edu Teck Pvt Ltd (formerly Globarena Technologies)
target_customers: state and central school boards, technical, medical and general universities, certification bodies

handwritten_reading.evidence: Scans answer books (uncut) for human examiners; no machine reading of handwriting documented

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: Human examiners mark scanned scripts on screen; no AI marking documented

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: Customizable marking rubrics and scheme of evaluation

partial_marks_feedback.evidence: Multi-colour annotation tools incl. comments; instant mark calculation and aggregation

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Scanning module scans answer books without cutting or de-threading; secure upload and storage

student_identification.evidence: API connectivity with student databases; student details hidden from examiners

annotated_copy.evidence: Annotation tools; vendor says ~95% of CBSE students who sought answer-sheet copies received them (2026 news)

teacher_review.evidence: Seed scripts for standardization, double marking, real-time examiner monitoring, discrepancy reports

public_api.evidence: API connectivity with student databases and bulk import/export; no public evaluation API docs

scale.customers_claimed: 35+ universities and institutions; close to 2 crore answer booklets a year (vendor statement in 2026 news); site claims 6,561+ satisfied clients

notable_2025_2026: Won the CBSE on-screen marking contract (finalised December 2025) for 2026 Class 12 evaluation; the rollout drew complaints over scan quality, which Coempt attributed to the scanning stage (June 2026).

name: Saras eMarking
target_customers: awarding bodies, exam boards, universities (largest named client is UK board AQA)

handwritten_reading.evidence: Case study: AI transcription of scanned handwritten scripts for a UK awarding body, giving examiners a transcript

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: 'Assisted scoring workflows' as an optional AI capability under human oversight; Dec 2025: marking exams 'will remain a human process'

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: Marker standardization and benchmarking documented; per-question scheme feature not described

typed_answers.evidence: Evaluates essay and descriptive responses, online and HTML-based digital responses alongside scanned scripts

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Integrates scanned answer scripts at scale; OCR-enabled script digitization

teacher_review.evidence: Moderation workflows, multi-marker evaluation, variance analysis; decisions remain under human oversight

public_api.evidence: Integrates with exam management, SIS, ERP, LMS; no public API docs found

integrity_checks.evidence: Plagiarism detection listed as an optional AI capability

scale.customers_claimed: AQA platform to cover ~12 million scripts a year and ~40,000 examiners when fully implemented (2026 news)

notable_2025_2026: Signed a multi-year deal with UK board AQA (May 2026) to build its next e-marking platform on Saras, after a December 2025 joint AI taskforce on AI-supported marking of handwritten scripts.

name: Mercer | Mettl Digital Evaluation (onscreen marking)
target_customers: universities, business schools, schools and coaching institutes running exams on Mettl

handwritten_reading.evidence: Not documented on the evaluation page

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: Evaluators and moderators mark assigned answer sheets; AI is described only for proctoring

typed_answers.evidence: Integrated platform to conduct, proctor and evaluate online exams; evaluators mark answer sheets in dashboards

indian_languages.evidence: 'Support 20+ languages' is stated for the exam platform, not specifically for evaluation

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Scanning of paper scripts not documented on the evaluation page

student_identification.evidence: Not documented; page covers masking of student information

teacher_review.evidence: Assign sheets to evaluators and moderators; multi-evaluation; admins can review any evaluation anytime

public_api.evidence: API-based integration to ERPs; no public evaluation API documented

integrity_checks.evidence: AI-assisted proctoring during exams; no plagiarism checks on answers documented

scale.funding_or_owner_notes: Part of Mercer. Testimonials on page from ISB, NISM, Vidyamandir Classes

name: DEXIT On-Screen Marking (OSM)
company: DEXIT Global Ltd (formerly NSEIT Ltd), CL Educate group
target_customers: universities, boards, recruitment and certification exam bodies

handwritten_reading.evidence: Scripts are scanned for human evaluators; no machine reading of handwriting documented

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: Authorized evaluators access, review and award marks digitally; no AI marking documented

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: Configure subjects, question papers, schedules and evaluation schemes; structured marking panels

partial_marks_feedback.evidence: Annotation and marking tools with automated mark compilation; written reasons not documented

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Answer scripts are scanned, indexed and uploaded; high-volume evaluation

student_identification.evidence: Barcode-based script identification, tracking and allocation

teacher_review.evidence: L1, L2, moderation and reconciliation workflows; escalation management; audit trails

question_paper_import.evidence: Question papers can be configured; import from an uploaded paper not documented

scale.customers_claimed: Company-wide: one digital exam for 73 lakh+ candidates; owned test centres in 230+ cities (OSM-specific numbers not published)
scale.funding_or_owner_notes: Digital exam (DEX) business of NSEIT bought by CL Educate for INR 230 crore upfront + INR 75 crore earn-out, closed January 2025

notable_2025_2026: CL Educate closed its acquisition of NSEIT's digital exam business (now DEXIT Global) in January 2025.
